desc: The PX-9 Duty Comp is the next evolution of the proven PX-9 series. Now equipped with a match-grade barrel and a compensator port, it offers exceptional recoil control for faster follow-up shots. The slide features aggressive serrations and machined cuts for reduced weight and enhanced grip. Designed with both duty and competition in mind, it utilizes high-capacity P226-pattern magazines and includes a factory RMR optic cut for co-witnessing with standard sights. Ambidextrous controls and reversible aluminum magazine release make it ideal for left- or right-handed shooters. With 27 ergonomic grip configurations, upgraded aluminum trigger, take-down lever, and magwell, this striker-fired 9mm delivers high-performance features at an unmatched value.
